rubric_items.reason: Every ticket ask (AC1-AC8) maps to a requirement. The undefined glossary terms, the PRD references, the list filter design and the time zone are under Out of scope, each with a reason.
Each requirement covers one behaviour that a tester can check. AC3 and AC8 are split into atomic items. REQ-12 and REQ-13 now have the same scope (tile, dashboard, linked list).
Every known item cites its ticket line. REQ-13 is no longer narrowed. The uncited claim about an existing implementation is gone from the Summary.

The clash between the glossary Period entry and AC4 is recorded with both cites, and the glossary is flagged for an update. It is resolved in favour of the explicit ticket rather than asked as a question.
No questions are asked, and none are needed: every ask is stated directly in the ticket, and the contract choices are left to the impact and design steps.
The wording is plain and glossary terms are used consistently. Missing glossary terms are flagged in the front matter and in Out of scope.
